summary: The domain can be spoofed in the From line: there is no enforced DMARC policy.

findings.title: No SPF record
findings.detail: Any server can claim to send mail for this domain, and receivers have no list to check against.

findings.title: No DMARC record
findings.detail: Receivers are not told to reject mail that fails SPF and DKIM, and the owner gets no reports.

findings.title: No DKIM key at common selectors
findings.detail: Selectors cannot be listed from DNS, so this is not proof that DKIM is missing. Check a real message's DKIM-Signature header.

findings.title: No MX records
findings.detail: The domain does not receive mail. It can still be spoofed as a sender unless SPF and DMARC say otherwise.
